patch_description: Structural redesign as a staged pipeline around a locally-adaptive-Q Kalman/RTS-style smoother. Instead of one global process noise (or a fixed SG window), the algorithm now: (1) Hampel-denoises the input, (2) estimates local signal dynamics σ_acc(k) via MAD of second differences over 50%-overlapping blocks, linearly interpolates the per-sample process noise Q[k] (floored/capped around a reference level) so fast segments (e.g., 5 Hz component) get larger Q and slow trend segments get smaller Q, (3) runs a forward constant-velocity Kalman pass with per-step Q[k] and innovation-EMA-adaptive R, (4) runs a backward pass on the forward estimate with Q scaled 0.25× and blends for zero-phase output, and (5) applies a light short-window Savitzky-Golay polish to further cut spurious slope reversals. This removes the single global smoothness/responsiveness trade-off that caused lag on fast segments while keeping the low slope-change and reversal counts, and improves maintainability via small single-responsibility stages.
